Pl let us know what share does my friends wife get as my friend belongs to AhleHadis & how to share the property, Question: Assalaamaliakum One of my friend aged around 40yrs had been married few months back & died in road accident after about 6 months of married life & they have no children.Iddat peroid of his wife has been over. My friend has 3 brothers & two sisters one married & the other a widow who stays with brothers as her daughters have been married off. Pl let us know what share does my friends wife get as my friend belongs to AhleHadis & how to share the property, Answer ID: 13183 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 78/620=L/1430) If none of the parents of your friend are alive, his left property and wealth will be distributed in 32 shares, out of which the brothers will get 18 shares (6 shares to each), the sisters will receive 6 shares (3 to each one) while the wife will have 8 shares. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
